items.title: Sense pedagogia no hi ha mediació
items.summary: En aquesta vida tot s’aprèn, i s’aprèn practicant. Potser calia posar certs límits a l’allau de feina mediadora que assumia el servei públic, però veient el panorama actual és evident que s’ha anat d’un extrem a l’altre,…
items.titleEn: Without pedagogy, there is no mediation.
items.summaryEn: In this life, everything is learned, and it's learned through practice. There may have been some limitations on the mediation work of the public service, but in the current scenario it is clear that it has gone from one extreme to the other.
